source: Ajuste SINIEF 03/2001, Anexo Codigo de Situacao Tributaria (CST), Tabela A (Origem da Mercadoria ou Servico) and Tabela B (Tributacao pelo ICMS)
Instrucao Normativa RFB no 1.009/2010 (Tabela de Codigo de Situacao Tributaria referente ao IPI)
Tabelas 4.3.3 (saidas) e 4.3.4 (entradas) do Guia Pratico EFD-Contribuicoes (Receita Federal) for the PIS/COFINS CST table
note: The ICMS CST is a 3-digit code formed by concatenating a 1-digit code from Tabela A (origem, 'icmsOrigin' below) with a 2-digit code from Tabela B (tributacao, 'icmsCst' below) - e.g. '110' = origem '1' + CST '10'. IPI and PIS/COFINS each use their own, unrelated 2-digit CST table ('ipiCst' and 'pisCofinsCst'); PIS and COFINS share the same table. Provided as four separate sub-tables (rather than one flat list of concatenated ICMS codes) since that is how the official legislation defines them and how downstream validators combine them.
